scores.note: Global admission and graceful close were incomplete.
Target forms were identified, but conflicting-target validation was not explicit.
Exact-input inference reuse was explained; the historical source predates current saved-answer lookup.
Timeouts, leases and partial publication were strong; retry backoff and nonblocking boundaries were incomplete.
Authentication and same-origin checks were strong; URL credential and request-bound coverage was incomplete.
Cloud opt-in and fixed origin were recovered; redirect, proxy and key-confinement details were incomplete.
Safe audit fields and prompt/source exclusion were recovered; answer-text and lease-token exclusion was not explicit.
SSE routes and persisted answer delivery were identified; heartbeat, lifetime and polling mechanics were omitted.

presentation_findings: One discoverBatches citation contains a concatenated 96-character symbol ID; its path, name and line span remain correct.
The agent downloaded the OpenAPI contract twice after its initial sandbox failure.
